entries.name: Mandela County
entries.content:
Mandela County is a United States county located in southeastern Wisconsin. It is close by or bordering the Bythorne, Werksha, and Yonder counties. It is south of Bythorne. Mandela County is based on Washington County, WI.
The population of Mandela County is 1,075 in 2009. Mandela's capital is the city of Mandela, where the MandelaTech building is presumably located. Mandela County may also have another settlement named St. John. Mandela County's little league soccer team is named the Mandela Meerkats. Mandela County is currently the only place that is infested with Alternates, as there is no sighting of Alternates onto different countries.

entries.name: Archangel "Gabriel"
entries.content: Archangel Gabriel the first Alternate. It's real name is Lucifer. It is a Type Two where it systematically sabotaged the Annunciation, and presumably prevented Christ from being born. After this, it claims itself to be the "one true savior" of humanity, implying that it has taken Christ's role in history. This so-called Gabriel is a pale-skinned, blond-haired archangel seen wearing white robes. When showing their true appearance their eyes grow in size and their mouth is stretched into a smile. This alternate has some slight differences from true Archangel Gabriel, such as a longer face and hair and a lack of wings. "Gabriel" often speaks in a whisper. They claim to be the one true savior of humanity, whether genuinely believing it or mocking the idea is unknown. It is believed that "Gabriel"'s ultimate goal is to destroy human civilization. It's the creator and progenitor of all alternates, and it commands them to kill people all over Mandela County.

entries.name: Alternates
entries.content: The Alternates are sinister and enigmatic beings. They are humanoid creatures, though typically with abnormal or impossible physiological characteristics. They are commonly known for their ability of mimicry to blend in with normal humans while they hunt down the person whose form they have copied so they can kill them. Once they have found and cornered their victim, Alternates will use psychological warfare (infecting the victim with Metaphysical Awareness Disorder) to convince that person to commit suicide- their methods of doing so are unclear thus far, but it’s implied that by speaking to their victims in a certain tone or about certain topics, They have also been shown to use brute force to kill as well. Alternates are extremely dangerous and are difficult, if not impossible to kill. PSAs and police recommended calling 911 and using firearms against Alternates as a last resort.

entries.name: Threat Types
entries.content:
Currently, there are only four types of Alternates:

1. Type One:
Doppelgänger: Perfect or near identical copies of someone. They are almost, if not completely impossible to differentiate from the original.

2. Type Two:
Unspeakable, Previously known as "Detectable" : Unspeakables are the second category of alternate in which Alternate Gabriel belongs to. Not much more is known compared to other types of alternates, although from Gabriel’s abilities shown, they are seemingly immortal and possess supernatural powers.

3. Type Three:
Flawed Impersonators/Overdriven Assimilations: Extremely flawed copies of their original counterpart, possessing missing or exaggerated features such as extremely long limbs, faceless heads, or even having entirely upside-down anatomy.

4. Type Four:
Tulpa: Alternates willed into existence by the imagination of an individual, mainly children. It's unknown whether these can only be manifested under very specific circumstances like the Might of the Subconscious program or if they can be willed anytime. It's thought that they might manifest through TVs and Mirrors.

entries.name: The T.H.I.N.K Principle
entries.content:
Incase of an Alternate encounter, the THINK principle needs to be followed. This principle is drawn up by the authorities for the safety of citizens when attacked by Alternates.

1. T-TELL an authority figure about your encounter.

2. H-HINDER the alternate's movement.

3. I-IDENTIFY the class type.

4. N-NEUTRALIZE the alternate (if safe to do so).

5. K-KNOW YOUR ENEMY.

entries.name: M.A.D
entries.content:
Metaphysical Awareness Disorder, also known as M.A.D is a psychological or mental illness brought upon by Alternates giving humans verbal information that is not desired to be known by them. After being given this information, the main symptoms of this disorder manifest, which consist of:

1. Going insane, or hence mad.

2. Extreme desire to kill yourself/commit suicide.

3. Becoming delusional and paranoid.

There has been a 95% increase of diagnosis of this disorder in the 3rd quarter of 1982, the current year of Volume 1. The death rate of M.A.D victims is currently 97%, 100% of these deaths by suicide. However, the remaining 3% of the M.A.D victims proves the effectiveness of the delusion reversal.

To avoid the development of M.A.D, one needs to:

1. Avoid excessively frequent religious practices.

2. Avoid unnecessary beliefs in philosophical implications.

3. Avoid opening their eyes when they are certain that the "man in the corner" is now inches away from their face. Watching.

Metaphysical Awareness Disorder is a fatal mental illness that has been making a certain return in recent months. Avoiding the root causes of Metaphysical Awareness Disorder development is the first step to being safe. First. Avoid excessively frequent religious practices. Avoid unnecessary beliefs in philosophical implications. Last but not least, looking after your loved ones is a key factor for maintaining mental stability.

entries.name: The Intruder
entries.content:
6, otherwise known as the Intruder, is a mysterious force which caused the disappearance of 3,426 children throughout several counties, resulting in the ban of most screen-based technologies and mirrors by 2009. 6 works under Archangel Gabriel, as it is still an Alternate.
6 takes on two forms:

The first being a tall, pale faced man wearing a black hoodie or robe. Mark originally depicts them with a large smile.

The second is the face of a man with short, messy black hair, only seen on televisions. Occasionally his expression changes to an eerie smile.
